goal: I am a software developer. I need to modify the seat booking functionality to introduce new booking rules. Before making changes to the code, I need to understand the high-level architecture supporting this functionality. I want to identify the main components involved in the booking process, their responsibilities, and the interactions and dependencies among them. In particular, I need to understand which components are responsible for handling booking requests, checking seat availability, applying booking rules, managing and storing reservations, and interacting with external services such as the notification service. This understanding will help me identify which parts of the system need to be modified and which other components may be affected by the changes.

views.title: Decomposition view — seat booking functionality (layered)
views.purpose: Which components take part in seat booking, what each is responsible for, and in which layer it sits

elements.name: ReservationController
responsibilities: exposes the REST endpoint POST /api/reservations/create for booking requests
exposes REST endpoints to cancel and check in a reservation

elements.name: ReservationSummary
responsibilities: submits the seat booking request chosen in the Swing wizard through LibraryFacade

elements.name: LibraryFacade
responsibilities: forwards makeReservation requests to ReservationManager
forwards sendReminders to NotificationManager

elements.name: ReservationManager
responsibilities: orchestrates the seat booking use case (makeReservation)
checks that the room is active and open on the date (weekdays only)
rejects time slots that have started or passed
checks that the requested seat belongs to the selected area
enforces one active or confirmed reservation per student, date and time slot
rejects the booking when no seat is available in the area
uses the requested seat or delegates automatic seat assignment to the strategy
creates the reservation in ActiveState and saves it
serialises the booking critical section
attaches NotificationManager and notifies observers after saving
cancels reservations, performs check-in and ends elapsed reservations

elements.name: FirstAvailableAssignment
responsibilities: assigns the first available seat (default AssignmentStrategy)
defines the seat assignment strategy used for automatic assignment

elements.name: NotificationManager
responsibilities: receives reservation changes as Observer and sends the message matching the status
sends notifications through NotificationService and discards them when none is configured
sends reminders for ACTIVE reservations of the current day
builds the message text for each reservation status
observer contract notified when a Reservation changes

elements.name: NotificationServiceAdapter
responsibilities: adapts NotificationService to the external email gateway, one email per recipient
fails the delivery when the gateway does not answer 200
defines the notification delivery port used by NotificationManager

elements.name: ExternalEmailGateway
responsibilities: stands in for the external email service and returns an HTTP-like status code (stub)

elements.name: Reservation
responsibilities: holds date, seat, time slot, student and persisted status of a booking
delegates cancel, check-in and end handling to its current ReservationState
rejects cancellation less than 6 hours before the time slot starts
sets the check-in tolerance (10 minutes) used to validate check-in
notifies attached observers

elements.name: Student
responsibilities: checks whether the student already has an active or confirmed reservation for a date and slot

elements.name: Area
responsibilities: computes the seats of the area that are available for a date and time slot

elements.name: Seat
responsibilities: tells whether the seat is free for a date and time slot by checking occupying reservations

elements.name: ReservationRegistry
responsibilities: saves and updates reservations through PersistenceManager
finds reservations by seat, student, room and date
defines which statuses occupy a slot (ACTIVE and CONFIRMED)

elements.name: StudyRoomRegistry
responsibilities: looks up rooms, areas, seats and time slots through PersistenceManager

elements.name: PersistenceManager
responsibilities: saves and updates JPA entities inside transactions
builds and runs equality queries from field maps

limitations: Layer groups are not counted in the 15-element cap; the 15 components fill it
Not drawn (cap): StudyRoom, TimeSlot, UserRegistry, StudyRoomManager, StudyRoomController, JpaUtil, NotificationConfiguration, NotificationScheduler, ReservationState classes
NotificationServiceAdapter and ExternalEmailGateway sit in package boundary, so the layer alias places them in Presentation although they act as an adapter to an external service
AssignmentStrategy, NotificationService and Observer are merged into FirstAvailableAssignment, NotificationServiceAdapter and NotificationManager

responsibilities: MySQL database holding the persisted reservations, seats, areas and rooms
